name: Kash.click MCP Server
description: Exposes Kash.click API as MCP tools, enabling programmatic access to authentication, shop account management, sales creation, and electronic invoicing for shops. Kash is NF525-certified — the official POS compliance standard — and generates Factur-X (EN 16931) compliant electronic invoices automatically, making it fully ready for B2B e-invoicing.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Simple MCP server health check. Returns { result: 'OK' } if the server is alive.

tools.name: account_list
tools.description: List all Kash / free-cash-register.net accounts linked to an email address. Use this before account.create to check if the user already has an account. Returns an array of accounts, each with accountTitle, accountID, and a getOTPForAccount URL that can be used to request a one-time password (OTP) to retrieve the APIKEY. This endpoint is public and requires no authentication.

tools.name: account_create
tools.description: Create a new Kash / free-cash-register.net account. First call account.list to check if the user already has an account. Requires an email address and a shop name (accountTitle). Optional: configType to pre-load a dataset matching the business type (e.g. 'Restaurant', 'Bakery', 'Bar', 'Shops'...), plus address and legal info. On success, returns APIKEY and SHOPID and automatically initializes the session so all other tools can be used immediately. IMPORTANT: the user must validate their email via the link sent automatically, otherwise the account may be deleted after a period of inactivity.

tools.name: account_show_infos
tools.description: Retrieve all current settings of the authenticated shop account as a JSON object. Returns the full shop configuration: name, address, legal numbers, receipt options, order requirements, enabled features, delivery methods, webshop colours, and third-party integration settings. Useful before calling account_edit to inspect current values.

tools.name: account_edit
tools.description: Modify the settings of the authenticated shop account. All fields are optional. Covers: basic info (name, address, legal numbers), receipt display options, order requirements, feature flags (stock, barcodes, variations, webshop, coupons...), delivery method toggles, and third-party integrations (PayPal, Prestashop, Yavin, Viva.com).

tools.name: auth_request_otp
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 for in-conversation authentication. Sends a one-time password (OTP) to the user's email address. If the user has multiple accounts, provide accountID (obtained from account.list) to target the right one. On success, an OTP code is sent by email — then call auth.login.with_otp with that code.

tools.name: auth_login_with_otp
tools.description: Step 2 of 2 for in-conversation authentication. Exchange the OTP received by email for an APIKEY and SHOPID, and automatically initialize the session so all other tools work immediately. Call auth.request.otp first to receive the OTP by email.

tools.name: auth_logout
tools.description: Clear the current authentication session (APIKEY and SHOPID). After this, all tools requiring authentication will fail until a new login is performed.

tools.name: order_create
tools.description: Record a new sale in the connected shop. Input includes paymentMode, and items[]. Each item can be of type 'catalog' (with productId), « department » (with deptId) or 'free' (with title and price). Check if the client already exists using data_list_clients and if the client exists, only specify idClient. If provided, paymentMode should correspond to a payment ID from data_list_payments tool. Returns a sale confirmation including a link to the PDF invoice and a client payment page. Automatically generates a Factur-X (EN 16931) compliant electronic invoice for every validated order (payment ≠ -2). Kash is NF525-certified — all validated sales are immutable and auditable

tools.name: order_edit
tools.description: Modify an existing order by its ID. Use the payment field to control the order state: -2 = keep as unvalidated quote; -1 = validate as invoice without payment; a payment method ID = record an actual payment and validate the order. Items can only be changed on unvalidated orders. Once validated, only payments can be recorded.

tools.name: order_detail
tools.description: Retrieve full order information by its unique ID, including items, client data, payment mode, and total amount.

tools.name: data_list_orders
tools.description: List either : unvalidated orders (called quotes) with creation date between from_date_ISO8601 and to_date_ISO8601 OR validated orders (called orders, invoices) with date of value between from_date_ISO8601 and to_date_ISO8601. You can also filter delivery methods (using filterDeliveryMethod)

tools.name: report_get
tools.description: Download a synthetic HTML sales report for a given period. Omit all date fields for yesterday; y only = full year; y+m = full month; y+m+d = specific day. Returns an HTML summary with total revenue, order count, department breakdown, VAT summary, and payment methods. All reported data is NF525-certified — immutable, auditable, and compliant with tax authority (DGFiP) requirements.

tools.name: data_list_pending_orders
tools.description: Retrieve the list of unvalidated orders (that can still be modified)

tools.name: data_list_products
tools.description: Retrieve the list of articles (products) configured in the shop. Returns an array of products with fields like id, title, price, and departmentId. Optional parameter 'format' allows output as json, csv, or html.

tools.name: data_list_departments
tools.description: Get all departments (product categories) defined in the shop, including their names and default tax rates. Supports format=json|csv|html.

tools.name: data_list_department_groups
tools.description: Return the list of department groups, used to organize product categories. Each group may include multiple department IDs.

tools.name: data_list_vats
tools.description: Retrieve the list of VAT rates configured in the shop, including their title, rate percentage, and optional accounting chapter.

tools.name: data_list_clients
tools.description: Get the list of clients registered in the shop, including contact info, loyalty points.

tools.name: client_add
tools.description: Add a new customer to the shop's customer file. All fields are optional: name, surname, email, phone, address, company registration number, VAT number, barcode, private/public comment, blacklist status, birth date, etc. Use data_list_clients to check if the customer already exists first.

tools.name: client_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing customer by their ID. All fields are optional except the ID. Use data_list_clients to find the customer ID first.

tools.name: client_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove a customer from the shop's customer file by their ID.

tools.name: data_list_variations
tools.description: Retrieve product variations (declinaisons) such as size or color. Returns an array of variant definitions with value and optional price delta.

tools.name: variation_add
tools.description: Add a new variation type (e.g. "Size", "Color"). Requires a title. Use variation_choice_add to add choices afterwards.

tools.name: variation_edit
tools.description: Rename an existing variation type by its ID.

tools.name: variation_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove a variation type and all its choices.

tools.name: variation_choice_add
tools.description: Add a new choice to a variation (e.g. "Large" to "Size"). Requires title and idVariation. Optional: deltaPrice, position, description, ending, unavailable.

tools.name: variation_choice_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing variation choice by its ID. All fields optional except ID.

tools.name: variation_choice_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove a variation choice by its ID.

tools.name: data_list_delivery_men
tools.description: List all delivery methods available for the shop, such as in-store pickup, home delivery, or courier services.

tools.name: data_list_payments_modes
tools.description: Return the list of payment methods (e.g. cash, card, mobile payment) available for this shop.

tools.name: data_list_cashboxes
tools.description: List the registered cashboxes (physical or virtual) linked to the shop, including their current status and identifiers.

tools.name: data_list_delivery_zones
tools.description: Return all configured delivery zones, including area names, postal codes, and applicable delivery fees or restrictions.

tools.name: data_list_relay_points
tools.description: List all relay points where customers can pick up their orders, including address, city, and postal code.

tools.name: data_list_discounts
tools.description: Return all available discounts or promotions, including their names, types (percentage or fixed), values, and conditions.

tools.name: data.list.users
tools.description: List all users (cashiers, managers, etc.) associated with the shop, including their roles and identifiers.

tools.name: data_list_tables
tools.description: Retrieve the list of tables configured in the app, used for restaurant mode or table management.

tools.name: plu_add
tools.description: Add a new item/article to the shop catalog. Requires a title. Optional fields include price, department (deptID), VAT rate (vatID), barcode, stock, variations, and many more.

tools.name: plu_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing item/article in the catalog by its ID. All fields are optional except the ID. Use data.list.products to find the article ID first.

tools.name: plu_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove an item/article from the catalog by its ID.

tools.name: dept_add
tools.description: Add a new department (product category) to the catalog. Requires a title. Optional fields include VAT rate (vatID), price, discount, position, department group, and variations.

tools.name: dept_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing department/category by its ID. All fields are optional except the ID. Use data.list.departments to find the department ID first.

tools.name: dept_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove a department/category from the catalog by its ID.

tools.name: dept_group_add
tools.description: Add a new department group to organize product categories. Requires a title. Optional: position, accounting chapter.

tools.name: dept_group_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing department group by its ID. Use data_list_department_groups to find the ID.

tools.name: dept_group_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove a department group by its ID.

tools.name: vat_add
tools.description: Add a new VAT rate to the shop configuration. Requires a title and a rate (e.g. 20 for 20%). Optional fields: accountingChapter, legal mention.

tools.name: vat_edit
tools.description: Modify an existing VAT rate by its ID. All fields are optional except the ID.

tools.name: vat_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove a VAT rate from the shop configuration by its ID.

tools.name: payment_mode_add
tools.description: Add a new payment method to the shop. Requires a title. Optional: type (Cash, Credit_Card, Check, Bank_Transfer, Meal_Voucher, Holiday_Voucher, and refund variants), accountingChapter, fixedAmount, minimumAmount, maximumAmount, cashboxLock (0 = all cashboxes).

tools.name: payment_mode_delete
tools.description: Permanently remove a payment method from the shop by its ID. Use data_list_payments_modes to find the ID first.
